correctness.rationale: For dot X=-X+S, finite-state Markov chain gives unique invariant law by contraction. Zero stationary flux implies p_+-p_-=xp. Subtracting running-state transport equations yields derivative[(1-x²)p-p_0]=-axp, integrated from x to endpoint with vanishing endpoint current; evenness gives the integral over |x|. The mixed moment formula follows by Fubini; the total M_(2k) hypergeometric expression is credited to Sun–Ye–Podgornik. At t=a+1 the three explicit beta-profile densities satisfy all stationary forward equations with integrable zero boundary currents. Conversely the conditional binomial moment identities E[S|X]=X and E[S²|X]=(1+X²)/2 plus stationary X² and XS give E[X²]=1/(2a+1) and E[S²]=(a+1)/(2a+1), and stationary motor balance E[S²]=t/(a+t) forces t=a+1 (a>0). Includes a+t=1 without division by zero and both endpoint regimes. Independent rational stationary generator moment checks (168 cases) corroborated.

limitations: Joint-density identities hold almost everywhere in (-1,1), with weak interpretation at integrable singularities.
